other_conditions: Applicant must be physically fit and free from communicable diseases
Attendant (if any) must be over 18 years old and pay 50% of travel cost via a bank draft
Joint applications of married couples are allowed, and one spouse may be under 60 years
Pilgrims can avail the benefit only once in a lifetime
False information will lead to debarment from the scheme
benefits_summary: Provides a one‑time fully funded pilgrimage journey for senior citizens (60‑75 years) from Odisha, covering travel, accommodation, meals and related support.
documents_required: Any other State Government document indicating weak economic status
